orderbook_histogram.json.provenance: Controlled synthetic test vector modeled on Steam /itemordershistogram response structure for AK-47 | Redline with exact Decimal bid levels (22.50, 22.45, 22.00, 20.00) and ask levels (24.88, 25.00, 26.00) to verify deterministic minor-unit conversion.
orderbook_histogram.json.notes: Used for verifying non-float orderbook depth parsing, highest buy order minor parsing (2250), lowest sell order minor parsing (2488), and top quantity extraction.

malformed_histogram.json.provenance: Handcrafted synthetic error test vector replicating Steam response when item_nameid is missing, invalid, or unindexed.
malformed_histogram.json.notes: Used for verifying that parsed.success=0 does not crash the parser and that highest_buy_order_minor gracefully returns None.

standard_render.json.provenance: Real normalized API capture from Steam Community Market legacy render endpoint for AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested), captured during Phase 1 research. Listing IDs and asset IDs randomized for privacy.
standard_render.json.notes: Used for verifying listinginfo dictionary parsing, fee breakdown fields, and nested asset descriptors.

grouped_ssr_data.json.provenance: Real normalized payload extracted from modern May 12, 2026 React SSR hydration tag (<script id="valve-ssr-data">, loaderData[3]) for grouped AK-47 | Redline URL.
grouped_ssr_data.json.notes: Used for verifying SsrListingLoaderData schema, wear bucket parsing (FN, MW, FT, WW, BS), localized names, and min_price minor conversion.

public_inventory.json.provenance: Real normalized public CS2 inventory snapshot from community profile, captured during Phase 1 research. SteamID64 and owner metadata anonymized.
public_inventory.json.notes: Used for verifying PublicInventoryResponse, asset/description association, and market_marketable_restriction integer days parsing.
